xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3151: Oversized changes do not converge under review→rework and nothing detects it

plan.title: Oversized changes do not converge under review→rework and nothing detects it
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: PAN-3093 (29 files, +5,594/−402) ran five review cycles whose blocking-finding count did not converge (12 → 7 → 5 → 4 → 12), burning ~$98 and ~7 pipeline-hours, and nothing in the pipeline noticed. Planning does not bound the diff an xBRIEF may authorize, the review dispatcher does not treat a non-decreasing finding count as a signal, and the per-cycle trend is invisible unless someone manually diffs synthesis.md files.
narratives.Proposal: Three mechanisms: (1) record each blocked cycle's blocking-finding count (from synthesis.md '## Blocking Findings' heading count, report-sum fallback) into a persisted reviewCycleHistory at the reconcileJournalIntoCacheSync blocked-transition chokepoint, and when the series shows a reversal at n≥3 or two consecutive non-decreases, mark the issue stuck with reason 'review-not-converging', suppress the automatic rework re-drive, and surface needs-you with the count series; (2) a quality-lint 'projected-surface' error at plan finalize when the files_scope union exceeds 25 files or 6 subsystems without plan.metadata.sizeJustification; (3) render the count series in the dashboard issue view and pan show.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Disrupting PAN-3093 itself — its in-flight cycle finishes; this issue builds the missing gate, not that issue's disposition
- Changing reviewer prompts or the prompt-level convergence gate in roles/review.md:62 (that gate governs which findings reviewers may report; it cannot stop the loop)
- New lifecycle states or deacon gates beyond the existing stuck flag
- New chart components or color semantics in the dashboard
- Auto-splitting an in-flight non-converging change (the gate stops and surfaces; decomposition is the operator's call)

autoDecisions.summary: Hook cycle recording and gate evaluation into reconcileJournalIntoCacheSync's wasBlocked→nowBlocked transition, not the verdict CLI
autoDecisions.rationale: Every verdict path (pan done, deacon fallback, journal recovery, HTTP route) funnels through this transition — verified the hook at review-status.ts:696 is the only wiring of the feedback delivery. Hooking the CLI would miss journal and recovery paths.

autoDecisions.summary: Count blocking findings from synthesis.md first, raw reports only as fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: The synthesizer deduplicates cross-sub-role findings, and the '## Blocking Findings' heading count reproduces the issue's quoted numbers exactly (verified 12 on PAN-3093 cycle f75a76c4).

autoDecisions.summary: Convergence rule = reversal at n≥3 OR two consecutive non-decreases
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'fails to decrease across two consecutive cycles'; the reversal clause is needed so PAN-3093's actual signature (strict decrease then 4 → 12) fires at cycle 5 rather than after more wasted cycles.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate action reuses the existing stuck flag with reason 'review-not-converging'
autoDecisions.rationale: All deacon dispatch loops already skip stuck issues and the unstick route is an existing operator escape hatch; a new state would fork every one of those call sites.

autoDecisions.summary: Suppress rework re-drive inside deliverReviewVerdictFeedbackPromise as well as at the reconcile hook
autoDecisions.rationale: The function has direct callers outside reconcile (deacon-review-signals.ts:252, legacy-routes.ts:496, specialists/done.ts:244); the in-function stuck-reason check covers all of them.

autoDecisions.summary: Projected-surface thresholds of 25 files / 6 subsystems with sizeJustification escape
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3093 touched 29 files across ~6 subsystems — both dials would have flagged it. A hard error (not warn) because a warn is the 'nobody notices' failure mode this issue is about.

Create review-convergence module: run-dir discovery, cycle counting, pure convergence rule

expected_outputs: review-convergence tests pass (rule truth table + fixture-based counting)

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/review-convergence.ts exporting: (1) interface ReviewCycleEntry { cycle: number; runId: string; atCommit?: string; blockingCount: number; recordedAt: string }; (2) const REVIEW_CONVERGENCE_MIN_CYCLES = 3; (3) findLatestReviewRunDir(workspacePath): string | null — newest 'agent-*-review-*' directory by mtime under <workspace>/.pan/review (PAN_DIRNAME from src/lib/pan-dir/types.ts), falling back to .overdeck/review; (4) countBlockingFindingsForRun(runDir): number | null — synthesis.md heading count via countSynthesisBlockingFindings first, else sum of findBlockingFindings across the run's .md report files (excluding synthesis.md), else null when no artifacts exist; (5) pure evaluateReviewConvergence(counts: number[]): 'converging' | 'not-converging' implementing the D3 rule: not-converging when counts.length ≥ 3 AND (counts[n-1] > counts[n-2], i.e. reversal, OR both of the last two comparisons are non-decreases). Unit tests pin the full truth table: [12,7,5,4,12] fires at append of 12; [12,13] does not fire (n=2); [12,7,5,5,5] fires at the second flat comparison; [5,5,5] fires; strictly decreasing series never fires; empty/short series never fires; fixture dirs cover synthesis-first counting, report-sum fallback, and missing artifacts → null.

items.title: Given counts [12,7,5,4,12], evaluateReviewConvergence returns 'not-converging' (reversal at n=5); given [12,13] it returns 'converging'
Given counts [12,7,5,5,5] or [5,5,5], evaluateReviewConvergence returns 'not-converging' (two consecutive non-decreases); given [12,7,5,4,2] it returns 'converging'

Given a fixture run dir whose synthesis.md has 3 blocking headings and reports with different counts, countBlockingFindingsForRun returns 3 (synthesis wins); given a dir with no synthesis it returns the report sum; given an empty dir it returns null
findLatestReviewRunDir returns the newest 'agent-*-review-*' dir by mtime from .pan/review and falls back to .overdeck/review when .pan/review is absent

Wire cycle recording and the convergence gate into the reconcile blocked transition

expected_outputs: reconcile tests prove gate fires/suppresses correctly and converging series is untouched

narrative.Action: In reconcileJournalIntoCacheSync (src/lib/review-status-reconcile.ts), extend the existing `nowBlocked && !wasBlocked` branch (~:144-148). (1) Resolve the workspace path via resolveProjectFromIssueSync + 'workspaces/feature-<issue-lowercase>' (same pattern as review-verdict-feedback.ts:100-103 — wrapper only, never sub-repos, H1), find the latest review run dir, and count the cycle (cycle-counting item). When the count is null, log a warn and skip recording (FR-2) but deliver feedback as today. (2) Append { cycle: prior+1, runId, atCommit: reviewedAtCommit ?? undefined, blockingCount, recordedAt } to reconciled.reviewCycleHistory, deduping by runId so a sandboxed re-reconcile never double-records (NFR-2), and include the field in the dbUpsert. (3) Evaluate evaluateReviewConvergence on the appended series. On 'not-converging': call markWorkspaceStuck(issueId, 'review-not-converging', { counts }) (src/lib/overdeck/review-status-sync.ts:416), set stuck/stuckReason/stuckAt/stuckDetails on the reconciled object so DB and read model agree (H6), emit an error-level activity entry stating the full count series and 'not converging — consider decomposition (split the remaining work, or unstick to continue)', and SKIP the hooks.deliverReviewVerdictFeedbackHostSide call. On 'converging', call the hook exactly as today (NFR-4). Tests: reversal series marks stuck and hook not invoked; stall series marks stuck; converging series invokes hook and sets no stuck; same-runId re-reconcile appends exactly once; count-null path warns and still invokes the hook.

Suppress rework re-drive in deliverReviewVerdictFeedbackPromise when the gate is engaged

expected_outputs: feedback tests prove gated verdicts send no agent message but keep file + PR comment

narrative.Action: In deliverReviewVerdictFeedbackPromise (src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-feedback.ts:97), after existingStatus is loaded (~:104): when existingStatus?.stuckReason === 'review-not-converging', still write the feedback file and post the PR comment (record-keeping), but skip resolveIssueFeedbackTarget/messageAgent entirely; instead call surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou with a message containing the count series from existingStatus.reviewCycleHistory and the guidance 'review loop not converging — consider decomposition, or unstick to continue rework', and return agentMessageSent: false. This covers the direct callers reconcile never sees (deacon-review-signals.ts:252, legacy-routes.ts:496, specialists/done.ts:244). Tests: gated status → no messageAgent call, needs-you surfaced, feedback file written, result.agentMessageSent false; ungated status → unchanged behavior.

Add projected-surface quality-lint rule (25 files / 6 subsystems, sizeJustification escape)

expected_outputs: lint tests cover over/at-threshold, justification, and cancelled-item exclusion

narrative.Action: In src/lib/xbrief/quality-lint.ts add lintProjectedSurface(doc): QualityIssue[] and include it in lintPlanQuality (:405). Export consts PROJECTED_SURFACE_MAX_FILES = 25 and PROJECTED_SURFACE_MAX_SUBSYSTEMS = 6. Across non-cancelled items, collect metadata.files_scope entries; strip wildcard tails from globs before bucketing; count each literal entry as one projected file and each distinct first-two-segment path prefix as one subsystem. When files > 25 OR subsystems > 6, and plan.metadata?.sizeJustification is not a non-empty string, emit one plan-level (itemId undefined) error with rule 'projected-surface' whose message states both counts, both thresholds, and: 'split the work into independently shippable sibling issues per the swarm contract, or set plan.metadata.sizeJustification for genuinely inseparable work'. With a non-empty sizeJustification emit nothing. Tests: 26-file plan errors; 25-file plan passes; 7-subsystem plan errors; sizeJustification suppresses; cancelled items' files_scope excluded; --no-quality-lint already skips all lint (verify no plan-finalize.ts change needed).

items.title: Given a plan whose active items declare 26 distinct files_scope files and no sizeJustification, lintPlanQuality returns a 'projected-surface' error naming the counts and thresholds
Given the same plan with a non-empty plan.metadata.sizeJustification, lintPlanQuality returns no 'projected-surface' issue
Given a plan spanning 7 distinct first-two-segment subsystems, lintPlanQuality returns the 'projected-surface' error; files_scope of cancelled items is excluded from both counts
